title: Finite ind-etale refinement with locally ind-etale Cech terms
statement:
Let $b:U\to V$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated weakly étale morphism between qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism, sk-def-pe-morphisms]. Use the small pro-étale sites and universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. There is a finite covering family $q_a:D_a\to U$ in $U_{\mathrm{proét}}$, with every $D_a$ affine, such that the following holds. For every integer $n\ge0$ and tuple $(a_0,\ldots,a_n)$, the scheme
$$D_{a_0\ldots a_n}=D_{a_0}\times_U\cdots\times_U D_{a_n}$$
is qcqs and its composite $b_{a_0\ldots a_n}:D_{a_0\ldots a_n}\to V$ has a finite affine open cover $T_\beta$. Each $T_\beta\to V$ factors through an affine open $V_\beta\subseteq V$ with $T_\beta\to V_\beta$ affine pro-étale, that is, induced by a small filtered colimit of finitely presented étale ring algebras [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. No affine or weak-contractibility assertion is made about the whole fibre product when $U,V$ are not affine. The family may be empty when $U$ is empty. No coefficient or cohomological hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Theorem 2.3.4 and Proposition 2.3.3 (weakly étale / ind-étale permanence), with Remark 4.1.3 (every weakly étale Y -> X is Zariski locally on X and locally in Y_proet of the form Spec B -> Spec A with A -> B ind-étale): affine ind-étale refinements of weakly etale maps. This statement additionally packages finite affine covers and the locally ind-etale Cech intersections, via the flat diagonal; it does not assert that an arbitrary weakly etale affine is already ind-etale.

proof.text: Pull the affine cover of V back to U, refine by affine open covers of the components and take a finite subcover of U. For each resulting affine map X → W to an affine open W of V, apply RingHom.WeaklyEtale.exists_indEtale_comp to the map on global sections. Its faithfully flat ind-etale spectrum map D → X is surjective, pro-affine-etale, and has pro-affine-etale composite D → W. Transport along isoSpec. Compose with X → U and assemble the finite jointly surjective weakly-etale family. Every component map to U is quasi-compact because its source is affine and U is quasi-separated, so the finite cover is pro-etale.

Induct on the nonempty tuple length. A singleton product in Over U is isomorphic to its unique factor, which is affine, qcqs, and has the retained affine target factorization. In the successor case extend the product fan by a binary pullback with the new factor. Standard scheme quasi-compact and quasi-separated pullback instances, using the affine new factor and quasi-separated U, prove qcqs. Apply lem-sfb-indetale-pullback-charts to the preceding term and the retained factorization of the new factor through its source affine open. Transport along pullback symmetry and the product-fan isomorphism. The over-U triangle and pullback identity give the exact structural-map equality to V.

Take a finite subcover of the affine open cover of every tuple term. This preserves the chosen maps and their pro-affine-etale factorizations verbatim. The constructions already use small ring refinements and universe-u open covers, so no further universe reduction is necessary. Empty U gives an empty family automatically; there are no tuples indexed by an empty cover.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 2.3.4, Proposition 2.3.3(4), and Remark 4.1.3; Q6 gives ring-level affine refinement, finite open subcover construction and product-fan induction.

split_report.summary: Constructed a finite affine refinement using the existing affine weakly-etale refinement theorem. Verified the pro-etale covering on each affine open of U. An explicit induction restricts the previous Cech term to the affine target U_a of the next refinement and then uses affine base change and composition; qcqs gives the final finite subcover. No new node or statement change is needed.
split_report.blueprint: The argument realizes the finite ind-etale refinement and the locally ind-etale Cech-intersection paragraph described in the imported refinement paragraph.
